name: tokens
title: Theme tokens (lightTheme / darkTheme / spacing / typography)
description: Theme classes for haze-ui: `lightTheme`/`darkTheme` plus `spacing` and `typography`, applied to a root element to activate the `--haze-*` design tokens.
author: wmzy <https://github.com/wmzy>
docs: Theme setup item: the wrapper re-exports the 'lightTheme' (or 'darkTheme'), 'spacing' and 'typography' classes from 'haze-ui' and imports 'haze-ui/css/tokens.css'. Apply the classes to a root element to activate the --haze-* design tokens. Details: https://github.com/wmzy/haze-ui/tree/main/registry
